headline: Anthropic is running its own biology research lab
summary: Both reports say Anthropic is operating its own laboratory for physical biology experiments. One places it in San Francisco; the other frames it against the industry's claims that AI will help cure disease and its own researchers' warnings about AI risk. The two texts do not conflict.
